title: Test case: existence argument, no explicit code

claims.statement: There exists an encoder f: {0,1}^1000 -> {0,1}^2000 such that, with maximum-likelihood decoding g, eps(f, g) <= 585061/10000000 on BSC(1/10) with a uniform message.
For the same code and maximum-likelihood decoder, implemented as the exhaustive search in proof.md, g executes at most W <= 2^1009 operations of the bsc-ops-v1 model on every received word.
